Load libraries and load in data

```{python}
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *
LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)


url = "https://byui-cse.github.io/cse110-course/lesson11/life-expectancy.csv"
df = pl.read_csv(url)
```

REVIEW EXERCISE:

Can you get a dataset that includes 3 countries (pick the United States and two other of your favorites)?


```{python}
# three = df.filter(pl.col("Code").is_in(["USA", "ARG", "CAN"])) # this is another way to do it.
print(df.columns)
three = df.filter(
    (pl.col("Entity") == "United States") |
    (pl.col("Entity") == "France") |
    (pl.col("Entity") == "Japan") 
).rename({'Life expectancy (years)': 'Life'})

three
```

```{python}

display(
    ggplot(data=three, mapping=aes(x='Year', y='Life', color='Entity'))
    + geom_line()
    + scale_x_continuous(format='d')

    + labs(
        title="Life Expectancy Over Time",
        x="Year",
        y="Life Expectancy (years)",
        color="Country"
    )

    + theme_gray()
    + theme(
    plot_title=element_text(color='black', size=22, hjust=0.5),
    legend_title=element_text(color='black', size=16),
    legend_background=element_rect(fill='lightblue', color='black')
    #legend_position='none'

    )


)



```
